about.title: About Cumberland County Schools Calendars
about.content: Cumberland County Schools serves Fayetteville and Cumberland County, including a large military-connected community near Fort Bragg. The district publishes multiple school calendars with different opening dates and break structures. Use the calendar assigned to the student's school or program.

content: Confirm whether the student's school uses the Traditional, Year-Round, early-college, or Cumberland Polytechnic calendar before arranging childcare or travel.
Check the individual school's bell schedule for exact dismissal times on two-hour early-release days.
For enrollment, school assignment, IEP, 504, or transfer-service questions, contact CCS directly rather than relying on calendar dates.

districtFaqs.q: Does every Cumberland County school use the same calendar?
districtFaqs.a: No. CCS publishes separate Traditional, Year-Round, Cross Creek and Cumberland International, and Cumberland Polytechnic calendars. Families should use the calendar assigned to their school or program.

districtFaqs.q: Where can military-connected families find CCS transition help?
districtFaqs.a: CCS provides Military Connection resources and Military Family and Youth Liaisons for families near Fort Bragg. Contact the district directly for enrollment, school assignment, IEP, 504, or transfer-service questions.
